dct_creator_sm: Grew, Ashley (Queen's University. Department of Biology).
dct_description_sm: Supplementary data for Ashley Grew's MSc thesis on the multistressor impacts of low water calcium concentration and heat waves on the growth, survival, and total body calcium content of juvenile Northern Clearwater Crayfish. This dataset includes R software scripts containing data analyses as well as spreadsheets containing all raw data used in this thesis.
dct_title_s: Heat Waves, Calcium, and Crayfish: Effects of multiple stressors on juvenile Northern Clearwater Crayfish (Faxonius propinquus) physiology
